from_quote: it will be necessary to repeat the remark in my last number, that the mode of legislation in the infancy of free communities was by the collective body
rationale: The paragraph refers to a remark in Cato's "last number"; the remark, that before legislating by deputies the whole free community met, is in this paragraph of Cato 5.

from_quote: representatives and direct taxes shall be apportioned among the several states which may be included in this union, according to their respective numbers, which shall be determined by adding to the whole number of free persons, including those bound to service for a term of years, and excluding Indians not taxed, three-fifths of all other persons.
rationale: The paragraph quotes in quotation marks, as "the words, as expressed in this article", the apportionment clause (with "in this union" for "within this Union").
to_quote: Representatives and direct Taxes shall be apportioned among the several States which may be included within this Union, according to their respective Numbers, which shall be determined by adding to the whole Number of free Persons, including those bound to Service for a Term of Years, and excluding Indians not taxed, three fifths of all other Persons.

from_quote: when they are connected with the executive, by the appointment of all officers
rationale: The paragraph names the senate's part with the executive in "the appointment of all officers", set in Article II, Section 2, clause 2.
to_quote: by and with the Advice and Consent of the Senate, shall appoint

from_quote: also to become a judiciary for the trial of officers of their own appointments
rationale: The paragraph names the senate's role as "a judiciary for the trial of officers", that is, the trial of impeachments.
to_quote: The Senate shall have the sole Power to try all Impeachments

from_quote: may be managed by the Senate and executive alone, and to have all the force of the law paramount without the aid or interference of the House of Representatives ; that is the power of making treaties
rationale: The paragraph names the treaty power exercised by the executive with the Senate.

from_quote: all which will become the supreme law of the land, and you are bound by it
rationale: The paragraph names the provision that treaties "become the supreme law of the land".
to_quote: shall be the supreme Law of the Land
